en.title: Pale Sunbeams and the Steam Whistle's Journey
en.premise: Swaying in an old steam train, I travel the world to record "delicious foods" and "mysterious customs." I have no specific destination; my days are spent writing in a diary about the scenery passing by the window and the small, precious stories of the people I encounter. But one day, after obtaining a ticket to the "Hill of Promises"—a place reachable only once every ten years—my journey begins to take on a slightly more special hue.

zh.title: 淡雅暖阳与汽笛之旅
zh.premise: 我乘着古老的蒸汽列车，在世界各地游历，记录着“美味佳肴”与“奇妙习俗”。我并没有特定的目的地，只是在日记中记录着车窗外的风景，以及旅途中邂逅的人们那平凡而动人的小故事。直到某天，我拿到了一张前往“约定之丘”的车票——据说那里十年才可抵达一次——我的旅程也随之染上了一抹特别的色彩。
